pkgmetadata.longdescription: shaodesk is a mouse-first Wayland desktop on wlroots: floating windows with edge snapping and optional tiling, a Qt Quick shell (taskbar, launcher, notifications, on-screen display), and a Lua configuration that reloads when it is saved.

use.flag: Serve desktop notifications (org.freedesktop.Notifications) from the shell
Build shaodesk-shell, the Qt Quick panels, launcher and notifications, with kde-plasma/layer-shell-qt
